title: Getaway to Shanghai | Timeless Treasures & Towering Heights
highlights: Discover Shanghai's history and modernity, where ancient traditions meet cutting-edge technology, offering a unique cultural experience.
Admire Longhua Temple, Shanghai’s oldest temple with a 40-meter pagoda, stands as a symbol to ancient architecture.
Visit Shanghai Zoo, famous for its rare species like giant pandas, and learn about its wildlife conservation in natural, well-maintained habitats.
Explore Shanghai Disneyland, the second-largest Disney theme park in the world, offering attractions like the Tron Lightcycle Power Run and Storybook Castle.
Hike the Jiangnan Great Wall, famous for its stunning views and rich history, offering a walk through an ancient part of China.
inclusions: Transfer from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
5 nights stay in Shanghai with breakfast
Shanghai Southern Great Wall Day Trip

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Carry a valid ID proof at all times.
The official currency is the Renminbi (RMB). Carry both cash and a credit card, as not all places accept cards.
Mandarin is the official language. English is not widely spoken, so learning basic phrases or using translation apps can be helpful.
Respect local customs, including bowing slightly when greeting and removing shoes in some homes or temples.
Tipping is not customary in China but may be appreciated in some high-end establishments.
Wear comfortable shoes for walking and be prepared for steep climbs at Jiangnan Great Wall.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Shanghai! Upon arrival at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get driven to your hotel. Check-in, and spend your time at leisure. You can take a scenic stroll along the Bund, soaking in the beautiful river views, or visit the Shanghai Museum to delve into China’s rich culture. For a unique shopping experience, you can explore Nanjing Road, renowned for its vibrant atmosphere and shopping options. Afterward, return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to discover Shanghai’s historical gems, beginning with the Jade Buddha Temple and its incredible jade statues. Next, visit the picturesque Yu Garden, a symbol of traditional Chinese gardens. Later, visit the ancient Longhua Temple, one of the oldest Buddhist temples and famous for its 10th-century pagoda. Conclude your day with panoramic views from the Oriental Pearl Tower and a serene Huangpu River cruise, where Shanghai’s modern skyline and Bund architecture meet.

days.title: Visit Disneyland | Meet your favorite Disney Characters
days.desc: Today, head to Shanghai Disneyland, China’s first and largest Disney park in Asia. Start with an adrenaline rush on the TRON Lightcycle Power Run, a high-speed coaster. Explore the Enchanted Storybook Castle, the tallest Disney castle ever built. Discover immersive lands filled with your favorite characters and enjoy captivating live performances. End your adventure with the Ignite the Dream fireworks show, blending fantasy with cutting-edge technology. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Full Day at Shanghai Zoo
days.desc: Today, spend the day at Shanghai Zoo, where you'll encounter over 6,000 animals, including endangered species like pandas and golden monkeys. Wander through themed zones and admire the diverse habitats created for the animals. The zoo’s educational exhibits offer a deeper understanding of conservation efforts, while interactive sessions make the experience even more engaging. After your visit, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Southern Great Wall Day Trip
days.desc: Today, head to Shanghai Station and upon arrival meet your guide. Board your bullet train to Linhai and start your tour. Walk along Jiangnan Great Wall, its ancient, weathered stones as you soak in the peaceful atmosphere and scenic views. Next, head to Ziyang Old Street, where history comes to life with traditional buildings and lively markets. The street offers a taste of local life, from crafts to regional treats. Afterward, board your bullet train back to Shanghai and return to your hotel.
